noveltyJustification: The per-track recompute exposed a 0.15-to-1.00 accuracy spread and a 16-of-20 abstention concentration in one track, reframing the p-value as a clustered claim, then confirmed the unpinned row set and out-dir truncation line by line.
keyQuestions: Q3: How to make the measurement more trustworthy?
answeredQuestions: Q3: How to make the measurement more trustworthy?

summary: Rows are 16 heterogeneous clusters, not 256 exchangeable draws: per-track accuracy spans 0.15-1.00 and abstention 0-0.80; sk-design alone abstained 16/20 and three tracks hold 32 of 57 abstentions.
The verdict sits 3.4 rows above the margin failure line and no condition's distance-to-threshold appears in the report.
The row set is unpinned: report stores counts only, calls store no question text, questions are re-derived per run, and the fixture promptSetHash is never checked.
Reusing an --out directory truncates calls.jsonl on first append and overwrites report.json; the 017 session already logged this as an unchased P2.
Requalify is print-only and fires only when provider or model changes; same-model reruns silently overwrite and no repeatability run is required.
Comparison targets the stronger lexical method (ripgrep), but only the path-only recipe is used; structured and count recipes exist unused, so a stronger baseline variant is available.
Label quality is unaudited; the sibling feature 022 fixture had its target wrong on every row, showing label risk is real in this family.
